lines: Here, where the current carried me.
Everyone bears a role and lives.
I become a single strand of algae.
The history that the current brought me to.
It has always moved forward, trembling of something.
I was too scared to open my eyes.
Now I feel I could believe.
At the bottom of the sea.
After fighting it, I finally met it.
I drew a hip that splashed water.
I was searching for something missing.
We who were swept away, everyone,
seems to have lost something before arriving here.
So it’s natural to feel sad,
With dry lungs I inhaled light at the bottom of the sky.
During the journey that circles the world,
we drew maps and sketched dreams,
searching for the meaning of breathing.
In this era, in this place,
A little more, a little more.
I drew a hip that splashed water.
I was searching for something missing.
In this era, in this place,
